name.en-US: A Meditation on the Incarnation of Christ
name.pt-BR: Meditação sobre a Encarnação de Cristo

description.la: Meditatio de incarnatione Christi secundum testimonia sanctarum scripturarum veteris et novi Testamenti, cum duabus orationibus. Textus ex editione Pohl (1904), cum versione Anglica V. Scully (1907).
description.en-US: A meditation on the Incarnation drawn from the testimonies of the Old and New Testaments, followed by two prayers (a salutation of Our Lord Jesus Christ, and a prayer to Christ the true light, way, truth and life). The Latin is Pohl's critical edition (Freiburg 1904), from a raw OCR of the printed volume; the English is Vincent Scully's 1907 translation.
description.pt-BR: Meditação sobre a Encarnação a partir dos testemunhos do Antigo e do Novo Testamento, seguida de duas orações: uma saudação a Nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo e uma oração a Cristo, luz verdadeira, caminho, verdade e vida.

sources.edition: Thomae Hemerken a Kempis Meditatio de incarnatione Christi, ed. M. J. Pohl (Freiburg: Herder 1904), Opera omnia III, pp. 1-47; archive.org raw OCR.
sources.description: The Meditation in two chapters (Old and New Testament) and the two prayers. Line numbers, running heads and page breaks stripped by script; Pohl's critical apparatus not imported. Raw OCR: drop capitals garbled, slips remain after the scripted repair.

sources.edition: A Meditation on the Incarnation of Christ, tr. Vincent Scully (London: Kegan Paul 1907); archive.org OCR.
sources.description: Same four divisions as the Latin. Running heads and page numbers stripped by script; margin scripture references removed where they interrupt a sentence; the translator's introduction and footnotes not imported. Raw OCR.

title.en-US: 3. A Prayer to Greet Our Lord Jesus Christ
